scope: Arithmetic and spatial mapping after RAW decoding, before NEFX serialization. Static recovery is not an authentic-image fidelity result.

function_map.role: Initialize merge context and place eight-input paths into internal slots 0..3 and 16..19.
Read, decode, preprocess, reconstruct, optionally correct, crop, encode, and write one output.
Four-frame metadata-selected sample correction for ISO at most 3200; complete branch equations remain to be normalized.
Two-frame vertical-offset averaging plus metadata-selected source replacement, ISO at most 3200.
Optional radial correction of red and blue planes using separate coefficient triples.
Separable four-by-four cubic resampling with output clamped to the supplied interval.
Apply CropArea and interleave three planes into RGB samples.
Build 640 by 424 preview using integer sample-area averaging.

input_slots.four_sixteen_thirty_two_input_placement: Input position i is copied to internal slot i.

preprocessing_dispatch.iso_source: EXIF tag 0x8827, copied into frame offset 0x1c8 and merge-context offset 0x1d0.

modes.high_iso: No preprocessing call before plane reconstruction.

modes.low_iso: Apply 0x18034ba60 separately to consecutive slot groups 0..3, 4..7, 8..11, 12..15.
modes.high_iso: No preprocessing call before plane reconstruction.

two_frame_preprocessing.definition: A and B are uint16 RAW planes with identical width W and height H. Only A is replaced.
two_frame_preprocessing.arithmetic: Operands are promoted to 32-bit unsigned integers before addition; unsigned shift by one floors the average. No additional gain, black subtraction, or saturation is applied by these averaging instructions.
low_iso_overrides: For each metadata-selected sample (x,y), replace Aout[y,x] with B[y-2,x].
Also replace Aout[y+2,x] with A[y+2,x], discarding the base average at that location.
two_frame_preprocessing.source_selection: The second pair member is displaced by two full RAW rows; the source row is y-2, not y.
two_frame_preprocessing.limitation: The physical sensor-displacement sign is not inferred from this buffer-coordinate relation. Metadata-selected row semantics and valid bounds require authentic files.

sample_selection_metadata.record_copy: Raw tag bytes 4..27 are copied into frame offsets 0x1e8..0x1ff, then into preprocessing argument offsets 0x28..0x3f.

fields.used_as: Horizontal half-grid minimum after division by two.
Second term of inner-loop count; total is byte22 + byte24 + 1.

selection_equations: Nested outer, middle, inner loops each start at one. Before iterations after the first, add that loop's row increment to the same cumulative y variable; y is not reset between loops.
For a selected row with 0 <= y <= H, set x=1 and iterate k=1..trunc(W/2)-2.
Accept k only when k >= floor(uint16le(tag,10)/2), k >= trunc((uint16le(tag,8)-W)/4), and k <= trunc((uint16le(tag,8)-W)/4)+trunc(W/2).
Only on accepted k, increment x by two unless k==1, then process sample (x,y).
limitations: Field names are operational descriptions, not Nikon-defined semantic names.
The observed row check alone allows y==H and does not protect y-2 or y+2; valid vendor metadata presumably constrains this, but that invariant has not been proved.
Do not classify this block as PDAF metadata or diffraction compensation without additional evidence.

plane_reconstruction.width_height_definition: W and H are decoded RAW buffer dimensions from TIFF image tags 0x0100 and 0x0101, not the visible CropArea.
plane_reconstruction.geometry_assumption: The normalized equations assume positive even W and H. The vendor's inclusive two-by-two block loops can write beyond the logical last column or row for odd dimensions; odd-dimension support is not established.

channel_table.interpretation_limit: The channel names follow the subsequent RGB interleave; the table is also consistent with an RGGB source mosaic.

equations: For group g and frame j in 0..3, A is the preprocessed RAW plane from slot 4*g+j.
For every logical pixel (u,v) in [0,W-2] x [0,H-2], destination is (scale*u+phase_x[g], scale*v+phase_y[g]).
Select output channel using row j of channel_table and parity corner (u mod 2,v mod 2).
If the selected channel is G and j>=2, output floor((existing_G + source_sample)/2); otherwise assign source_sample directly.
consequences: Each destination pixel has one red observation, two green observations, and one blue observation per four-frame group.
Sixteen-input mode places consecutive four-frame groups on output sublattices (0,0), (1,0), (1,1), (0,1).
Eight and thirty-two input modes first reduce repeated frame pairs, then use the four or sixteen input spatial mapping.
The reconstruction loop performs no interpolation for the basic spatial arrangement and no motion-dependent weight selection.
limitations: These indices refer to the caller-supplied order. Authentic capture identifiers must still be related to that order.
No conclusion about motion rejection elsewhere in NX Studio follows from the absence of such logic in this loop.
RAW decoder normalization, low-ISO preprocessing, and optional correction remain part of the total numerical pipeline.

internal_consistency_check.result: Every source index stayed in bounds and every destination pixel received exactly one red, two green, and one blue observations.

optional_radial_correction.enable_field: Merge context byte 0x4808, passed from the exported boolean option.
optional_radial_correction.execution_order: After RGB plane reconstruction and before final crop.

coefficient_source.container: TIFF SubIFD tag 0xc7d5 nested Nikon metadata, child tag 0x0007.
coefficient_source.endianness: little-endian int32 assembled from four bytes
coefficient_source.evidence: NefFileReader at 0x180343990 parses tag 0xc7d5 into frame+0x168; 0x180352250 extracts child tag 7 fields, which 0x180350590 copies into reconstruction parameters.

center_source.endianness: little-endian int32 assembled from four bytes
center_source.evidence: Frame fields +0x1d4 and +0x1dc are copied from first-frame context offsets +0x1dc and +0x1e4 to reconstruction-parameter offsets +0x90 and +0x98.

equations: For destination (x,y), dx=x-cx, dy=y-cy and t=sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)/radius.
For each of red and blue, k=1+a+b*t*t+c*t*t*t where a,b,c are that channel's signed integer coefficients divided by 1048576.
Resample that channel at (cx+k*dx, cy+k*dy); copy green unchanged.
optional_radial_correction.semantic_limit: The arithmetic matches lateral chromatic aberration correction; the public option name must be verified at the caller.

cubic_sampler.support: For each axis, sample integer positions trunc(coordinate)-1 through trunc(coordinate)+2.
cubic_sampler.boundary_behavior: Skip out-of-bounds source taps; weights are not renormalized.
cubic_sampler.conversion: Sum all valid sample*weight_x*weight_y products in double precision, clamp with fmax(sum,0) then fmin(...,16383), then truncate toward zero to uint16.
cubic_sampler.limitation: Negative coordinates use truncation toward zero, not floor. Exact floating-point parity requires testing against the vendor routine.

final_crop.source_tag: Nikon MakerNote 0x0045 CropArea: left, top, width, height as four uint16 values.
equations: Multiply all four CropArea values by scale.
Final width = scale*crop_width; final height = scale*crop_height.
final_crop.layout: Three consecutive uint16 values per pixel, in plane order 0,1,2.
final_crop.arithmetic_limit: The vendor doubles CropArea in 16-bit words and then sign-extends each word; a replacement should validate dimensions explicitly rather than inherit wrapping behavior.
final_crop.important_distinction: The intermediate one-pixel crop is not the final exported image size. Final visible dimensions come from CropArea.

verified_properties: Copies all four input planes and modifies only metadata-selected samples in the copies.
Uses neighboring aligned channels across the four RAW planes, local two-sample means, channel ratios, and row offsets up to two.
Contains selection tolerances 0.1, 0.3, and 0.4; blend weights include 0.3, 0.5, and 0.7.
Contains intensity thresholds 300, 500, and 2000 and caps corrected samples at 16383.
Copies corrected planes back to all four source vectors after processing.
low_iso_four_frame_correction.remaining: Normalize all ratio-selection branches and zero-denominator/NaN behavior into an independently reviewable specification; verify with a vendor routine oracle and authentic sensor metadata.
low_iso_four_frame_correction.semantic_limit: The metadata-selected sparse-row behavior suggests sensor sample repair, but an exact Nikon feature name is not established.

unverified: All formulas against actual vendor execution, especially floating-point and metadata edge cases.
Capture sequence identity and ordering in authentic pixel-shift files.
Complete low-ISO four-frame correction branch specification.
RAW decoder calibration and camera-specific normalization.
Numerical equality to authentic NX Studio NEFX output.
Lightroom Classic color and editing fidelity.
